title: Complaint of Moo S. Lim, et al. v. Korean Capital Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC ruled the complaint administratively out of order because it had not first been filed with and acted upon by the session as required by BCO 33-1.
first_summary: The SJC ruled the complaint administratively out of order because it had not first been filed with and acted upon by the session, as BCO 33-1 required.
summary: The SJC ruled the complaint against Korean Capital Presbytery administratively out of order. Because the complainants had not first filed the matter with, and obtained action from, the session as required by BCO 33-1, it was not properly before either Presbytery or the SJC. The ruling did not address the complaint’s merits.
